subject: System Design
title: Database Sharding Strategies
description: A 60-second lesson on Database Sharding Strategies.

hook.text: Your database has 2 billion rows. Even indexed queries are slow. It's time to shard.

buildup.text: Range sharding splits by value ranges. Hash sharding distributes evenly using a hash function.

discovery.text: Hash sharding prevents hot spots but makes range queries expensive. Range sharding is the opposite.

twist.text: Resharding — changing the number of shards — requires migrating billions of rows with zero downtime.

climax.text: Choose your shard key carefully. Changing it later is one of the most painful operations in engineering.

punchline.text: The shard key is a one-way door — choose wisely.

quiz.question: What is the downside of hash sharding?
